fullDesc: On October 4, 1957 the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite. The shock of it spurred the US to create NASA in 1958 and sparked the Space Race.
realFacts: It was about the size of a beach ball
It beeped for about three weeks
Laika the dog flew on Sputnik 2 a month later
The US responded with big investment in science education
